body:
On the owner's word the Astra host now answers under its Tailscale name, https://maciejs-mac-mini.tail69df8f.ts.net:47832, with a certificate that phones and the iOS app trust without a warning. The old IP address no longer works.

Nothing in the data changed: the instance, both profiles, the 13 sessions and the 15 projects were the same before and after the restart, and the agent and GitHub publication are still on. The iOS app, run in a clean simulator, reached the host's pairing page.

What the owner has to do once: pair each browser again under the new address, enter the new address in the Omarchy bar widget, and pair the iPhone app after installing it from TestFlight. The certificate renews itself when the host is started; it is valid to 2027-01-07.

Still unverified: the app on a physical iPhone.

metadata.summary: Host switched to its Tailscale name with a trusted certificate; browsers pair again once
